instructions_to_main_agent: This is an Enterprise Hospital Management system for Thai users. Do NOT use generic SaaS Blue. Stick to the Deep Forest Green and Bone White Earthy/Organic palette.
Implement pure HTML/Tailwind for structural layout components to achieve tight 'Control Room' grids. Use Shadcn components specifically for complex interactions (Tables, Modals, Forms, Select).
Avoid Glassmorphism on clinical data screens (Patient EHR, Dashboards). Use Flat Solid surfaces with 1px border. Refraction of data is forbidden. Glassmorphism can be used ONLY on the sticky header.
Data readability is the top priority. Use IBM Plex Sans Thai for body copy and data tables, and Prompt for Headings. Add these via Google Fonts.
Always include data-testid on interactive elements for QA.
Implement role-based sidebar menus that visibly toggle based on the 7 RBAC roles. Label unavailable modules as 'Coming Soon'.
Appointment Statuses must be color-coded distinctively (Scheduled=Warning, CheckedIn=Secondary, InProgress=Info, Completed=Success).
